name: Nothing But The Truth

faq.answer: Apothecary Faustin waits at Beggar's Haunt, an isolated outpost in Duskwood.
Apothecary Faustin requires five shadow panther hearts, Mire Lord fungus, and a deep strider tumor.
faq.q: What reagents does Apothecary Faustin require?

faq.answer: Apothecary Faustin is a Forsaken alchemist stationed at Beggar's Haunt in Duskwood.

sections.body: At Beggar's Haunt, Apothecary Faustin prepares a brew that demands rare reagents from the wild. He sends you into the wilderness to collect hearts from shadow panthers, along with Mire Lord fungus and a tumor taken from a deep strider.
sections.title: Reagents for the Apothecary

summary: Apothecary Faustin at Beggar's Haunt requires harvested reagents from across the wilderness. Gathering shadow panther hearts, Mire Lord fungus, and a deep strider tumor will supply his work in Duskwood.
attribution: In-game quest text: Nothing But The Truth
